snapshot.title: Remote ID Feed from Unknown Drone Over Fairgrounds

lines.msg: FAA UAS Facility Map: No registered ID for 0x7F9A2B8D (No ID)
Feed synchronized to GCS-01 (10.17.40.10) via UDP stream (port 50001)
Feed overlay active on GCS-01 (Hangar 1) — live Remote ID display enabled
Feed source: HWP-DETECT-01 (Harwick Police Detection Console)
Feed confirmed as non-GPS spoofed, valid broadcast
Feed status: active, persistent (tracking for 2.3 min)

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the drone is broadcasting a valid Remote ID and is visible on the GCS. The technical team must validate the feed’s legitimacy and confirm whether UAS-12 is airborne. The IC must initiate contact with Harwick Police and verify fleet status.
